observations: The first native attempt failed when the DEBUG marker write was denied by the Mac sandbox, after the real upload completed. Its exact checker object was verified and cleaned up.

The rebuilt app required a new private Keychain approval, provided by the user. A duplicate process launched during observation timeout was stopped; acceptance used the explicitly launched guarded process.
Two signing verification invocations rejected the wrong product directory and then the primary app namespace before signing. The secondary-stage verifier subsequently passed all four products.
The held-response run reported no AttributeGraph warnings; the subsequent normal-launch process reported seven. Their cause remains unresolved.
limitations: Paired native profile receipt, actual VoiceOver/keyboard, and broader P0/provider/widget-host/distribution acceptance are not claimed.
No private credentials, source task content, raw caches, source API token or screenshots are committed.
